brief.headline: Push to the market-fair band ₹0.65–0.80/pc and cut payment from 30 to 15 days to free up ₹2.60 L cash — we have five qualified alternates and six backup leads lined up.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹0.65–0.80/pc on the 28 mm cap
priceAsk.basis: The open-market ask for a 28 mm induction-wad PP cap runs ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc. The verdict is MARKET-FAIR with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec. Our ₹63.21 L annual spend gives us the scale to land in that lower band.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Cut payment terms from 30 days to 15 days after receipt
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Moves another 15 days earlier, freeing up ₹2.60 L cash for us

brief.financialLeverage: Bprex publishes no financials, so we can't see their profit, debt or how cash-tight they are. That means our leverage comes from our own data and our alternates. We spend ₹63.21 L a year with them on rigid plastic packaging — enough scale to matter. We have five qualified packaging suppliers already on file and six more backup leads to qualify, so we can credibly walk if they don't move. With no financial transparency, treat them as any private vendor: firm on price and payment, and line up a second source before the next tender.

evidence.point: Our annual spend with Bprex is ₹63.21 L
We currently pay them 30 days after receipt
Cutting payment to 15 days frees up ₹2.60 L cash for us
The market ask for a 28 mm induction-wad PP cap is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc
The verdict on that cap is MARKET-FAIR with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec
HDPE resin import unit value is 87.61 ₹/kg

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd (private)
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter — pharma bottles, caps, preforms; revenue ₹2569.83 Cr, health score B (65/100). Top second-source candidate.

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd (listed)
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader in pails, containers and pharma packaging — strong, profitable, robust alternate for bottles and closures.

alternates.name: IVL Dhunseri Petrochem Industries Private Limited (backup lead to qualify)
alternates.why: Manufacturer in India-East — a lead to qualify before issuing any RFQ; verify capability and pricing first.

risks: Bprex publishes no financials — we can't see if they're healthy or struggling, so watch for sudden delivery or quality issues that signal trouble.
We have no internal price benchmark (no bestPriceWePay data) — the market ask is our only reference, so validate the ₹0.65–0.80 band with a parallel RFQ to Manjushree or Mold-Tek before committing.
The six marketBackups are unqualified leads (Reliance, Srichakra, IVL Dhunseri, Dalmia, Ganesha, Chemco) — don't name them in the room until we've audited and priced them.
Cutting payment to 15 days may meet resistance if they rely on our 30-day float — be ready to trade the faster payment for a price cut in the ₹0.65–0.80 range.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're spending ₹63.21 L a year with you on caps and bottles, and we're lining up a second source to split that volume — let's talk about landing at ₹0.65–0.80/pc and moving to 15-day payment so we both benefit from the scale.
